title: Answer ceiling
what: The cut every verb's answer takes at 30,000 characters, keeping whole items and saying what was cut and how to ask for the rest.

title: Close line
what: One line per repository on a machine in which every close of that repository stands, keyed by its common git directory, holding the wide lane through each part of its check.

title: Declaration reader
what: Reads a repository's root testbed.toml into typed tables (test with its silence limit, projects, tools, check with its shared versions, build, deploy, runner, events), refusing unknown keys and another major, and finds the repository's root and paths.

title: Event hook
what: Sends a verb's event (deployed, deploy-failed, full-suite-failed, suite-flaky and the like) to the hook the environment or the declaration names, through sh with a JSON body, ending its process group past the policy's time; it never changes the verb's outcome.

title: Lanes and turn
what: The machine's wide and narrow lanes, each one queue lock in the temporary directory: taking a turn, the front and next ranks, held turns, kept places, the width a lane runs at, and the memory turn that retries a command killed for want of memory and stops at a fence's ceiling.

title: Languages
what: The language type in core and its members bun, node, cargo, browser and plain: what each claims as heavy, how it widens a command, reads a log, names and runs test files, hands a per-test limit or reads a test still running, and its configuration, root files and lockfile.

title: Main branch head
what: The head of a repository's main branch as its remote holds it: the remote's main fetched where a reader asks, then of the local branch and the remote-tracking branch the one holding the other, refused where neither stands or they parted. In core's main_branch module.

title: Placement
what: Where a run goes: here by default or where its environment names a variable as this machine's, else over ssh to another machine whose testbed must be this release, which a deployment brings there first; that machine is also laid units, read for free disk by drive and handed the release.

title: Policy loader
what: The testbed's own fixed numbers and words, one TOML part per file under policy/, compiled into core and read once into deny_unknown_fields structs; fill_marks and fill_shown fill a line's {name} marks.

title: Run verb and status
what: The run verb, which runs one heavy command in its lane's turn or places it elsewhere, tells a run witness as it begins and ends, and ends on one result line or one command run; and the status verb's lines over each lane, its placed runs and the close line.

title: Silence watch
what: The watch that ends a command holding a turn once its output and the BMO_TESTBED_HEARD file stay still for the silence limit, naming the processes still standing under it, in core/src/silence.rs; it also passes a placed run's output on through counted pipes.
